_comment: Everything the docs site needs that is not in the Markdown. Values starting with 'TODO' are placeholders — build.js prints a warning for each one that is still unfilled, and they render visibly on the site so they cannot ship by accident.
tagline: Everything you need to run Evoke
heroSubtitle: Set up, customize and get the most out of the Evoke theme. Search below, or pick a category to browse.
_company_comment: companyShort and companyUrl were removed — nothing rendered them. If Modern Grid gets its own site, add companyUrl back and the footer name can link to it.
_paths_comment: There is no baseHref setting. Every link and asset is written as a page-relative path, so the same build works opened straight off disk, at a domain root, and in a GitHub Pages project subdirectory — with nothing to configure.
